description: This file provides CRUD service functions for categories, tags, and a user list, designed for backend API responses in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: getAllCategories
methods.description: Fetches all categories ordered by name ascending.

methods.name: getAllTags
methods.description: Fetches all tags ordered by name ascending.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Fetches all users ordered by creation date descending, excluding password hashes.
